head.lede: Three projects we're actively building, plus a sample of past client work. Twenty years' worth of code doesn't fit on one page — what's here is what we think is most relevant to the work we're focused on now.

active.label: 01 · Currently building
active.title: In active development.
active.lede: Products we build and ship, and the agentic workflow we build them with.

image.alt: PipeBrain work board with a project switcher, verify and backlog counts, milestone progress, and a list of in-flight issues

items.title: PipeBrain
items.description: The work ledger behind software built by agents, and the workflow we use to speed up our own development. A person writes and approves the requirement, an agent builds each task, and a second agent runs its checks and records the proof. Some checks only a person can pass, so humans stay the gate. We use it every day — it's part of why we ship faster than firms our size usually can.

image.alt: DownBad domain health check findings for downbad.app: email security worth monitoring, with the SSL certificate, domain registration, DNS, and three endpoints looking good

items.title: Down Bad
items.description: 24/7 uptime monitoring with more features than the established tools, at a flat $50 a year — not per monitor, not per site. Built because we wanted better monitoring for our own infrastructure than the market was offering.

image.alt: KyntiQ screen for a contact named Maya showing her six-digit code, your code to share, and buttons to record whether the codes matched

items.title: KyntiQ
items.description: A family safe word that changes every minute. AI can copy a familiar voice from a few seconds of audio, so when a call asks you to send money or change a payment, ask “What's your KyntiQ Code?” Paired phones share six-digit codes that rotate every minute and are made on the phone, offline.

past.label: 02 · Selected past work
past.title: Client engagements.
past.lede: A sample of what we've built for businesses over the years. Some are anonymized; in most cases the work was internal and not public-facing.

image.alt: rLinc AI Assistant analytics dashboard with question and user counts, success rate, response time, cost, feedback metrics, and usage and cost time-series charts

items.title: rLinc
items.description: An internal operations platform for managing clients, work, employee workflows, and accounting. Recently extended with an AI assistant — approved employees can ask natural-language questions against company data, with usage, cost, and feedback tracked through an admin analytics dashboard.

image.alt: Accent desktop app personal meeting screen with launch controls and conference, huddle, and break room cards

items.title: Accent
items.role: Unified communications · desktop and mobile app
items.description: An all-in-one business communications app: cloud phone, video meetings, team messaging, and third-party integrations brought into a single desktop and mobile experience. Built so teams can place calls, host conferences, and collaborate without bouncing between tools.
